授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: Learning the basic theory of 2nd order PDEs. Strong emphasis on Equations of Elliptic, Parabolic and Hyperbolic type. Examples and exercises will be done in class.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: PDEs, harmonic functions, Separation of variables method
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs), Fourier series, linear algebra
